evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
rationale: This story provides the creation/ingestion capability (upload + tags) and is present; no complementary creation step is absent for the stated intent.

evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments

evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
rationale: Providing info about segments requires segments to exist and similarity metadata; backlog lacks a generic segment-generation story and general similarity-indexing creation for segments.

evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
rationale: This requires computed perceptual-similarity indices and segment-level feature extraction; there is no story that generically creates segment-level features or indices across videos.

evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles depends on stored user profiles and behavioral data; backlog does not include a story creating/storing user profile or activity histories needed for this.

evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area

evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them

evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
rationale: Product identification needs a product reference database and ingestion of product metadata; backlog contains no story to create or manage the product reference data required for returning related information.

evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
rationale: Logo identification requires a logo reference set and onboarding of logo templates; backlog lacks a complementary story to create/manage such a reference dataset.

evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
rationale: Brand identification similarly requires a brand database or knowledge base; no backlog story provides creation/management of that complementary resource.

evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
rationale: Cross-modal image-to-video retrieval requires indexing video frames/features and an image-to-video matching pipeline; the backlog has no story that creates the video-index or the cross-modal matching indices needed.

evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
rationale: This needs geo-tagging of videos and a geospatial index of content; the backlog has no story creating or ingesting geographic metadata for videos (geo-tagging), so the required complementary capability is missing.

evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
rationale: ASR-based search requires ASR transcription generation and indexing of transcripts; no backlog story creates transcripts or indexes audio speech for search, so complementary capability is absent.

evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
rationale: Editing segmentation presumes segment data exists; there is no generic story to automatically create video segmentation across the platform (only project-specific segmentation tasks), so the creation step is missing.

evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
rationale: Annotating segments and extracting topics requires that segments exist; generic segmentation creation is missing from the backlog, so a necessary complementary capability is absent.

evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects

rationale: This admin analysis story is self-contained (the capability to assess edit detection is the feature) and no additional creation step is required beyond ingestion (ZO-006).

rationale: Prefiltering nudity is an admin action that presumes a detection algorithm; the backlog includes prefiltering/admin stories and does not require an additional complementary create story to be specified here.

evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
rationale: Low-level feature extraction and search are covered by several preclassification/admin stories (e.g., ZO-030) so the complementary capabilities are present in the backlog.

rationale: The story itself specifies the automatic validation capability; no missing complementary creation step is evident beyond ingestion which is covered by ZO-006.

evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
rationale: High-level metadata/tags are created via upload (ZO-006) or recognition stories; complementary capability for using metadata in search is present in the backlog.

rationale: This depends on citizen annotations and Talk comment creation (volunteer-side annotation/comment submission) but the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to annotate or post Talk comments, so the complementary capability is missing.

evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
rationale: Detection based on annotations/Talk presumes those volunteer contributions exist; backlog lacks volunteer-annotation or Talk comment creation stories, so the required input is missing.

evidence: identify volunteer types
